label: Whatever concrete thing is present traces back to something concrete present at each earlier moment
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (a traced form of 'from nothing, nothing comes'): in every history of the model, for every concrete individual present at a moment t and every strictly earlier moment s, some concrete individual present at s is the same individual or is linked to it by a finite chain of grounding links. Intermediate links need not be concrete or present. Nothing is said about a first state with no earlier moment.
